adjudications.solutionNote: CISCE accepted both option (C) and option (D) for this question, because \(x^3 - x^2 - 4x + 4 = (x - 1)(x - 2)(x + 2)\) shares both \(x + 2\) and \(x - 2\) with \(x^2 - 4\).
